svg.text: OBJ-196 Planter, plant stand, disc base and two plates
Flat patterns at 1:4.8, outside dimensions, bend allowance not applied (Production). Red dash-dot = fold. Same frame as the DXF files.
الأنماط المسطحة، الأبعاد الخارجية، وسماحية الثني من التصنيع.
1 NEAR PLATE WITH BASE AND TOP FLANGES, 1 off
اللوح القريب بجناحي القاع والسطح، عدد ١
Ø204 hole opens to the fold
2 FAR PLATE WITH BASE AND TOP FLANGES, 1 off
Height to top face of top disc
Pot hole diameter in top disc
4 each plate, Ø5.5, at y +-95, z 60 and 340
Both plates and both flange pairs fold the same way: flanges point away from the gap.
Near plate window leaves 2 side legs of 64 mm; the pot passes the plate plane there.
Shelf (3): cut disc with a 20 mm tab, tab folds down and is joined to the near plate face under the window. Joint method is Production's.
Plates are tied across the gap by 4 spacers (Ø10 tube, 22 long, bolt or weld): bought-in, not drawn in detail.
الأجنحة تتجه بعيداً عن الفتحة. الرف بلسان مثني للأسفل. اللوحان مربوطان بأربع قطع تباعد.
